key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:select:0:267E6
name: store_indexed_table_entry
description: Stores a 16-bit index into a field of the current object, then writes the longword selected from a global lookup table by that index through a pointer held in the object.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:select:0:26870
name: reset_object_state_words
description: Clears five 16-bit state words in the object block and sets two other words to all ones, which resets the object's flags and counters.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0000
name: initialise_game_and_run_loop
description: Clears a 128-byte block to the value eighty and copies state into globals, then calls the routines that set up the frame before looping on a global flag until it is set. It restores the saved values and returns a result code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0006
name: start_game_loop_with_dma
description: Runs the same start-up and frame loop as the program entry, after touching the audio period, colour zero and DMA control registers of the custom chip block. Its body loops on a global flag until it is set and then restores the saved state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:01FC
name: set_marker_if_flag_clear
description: When a global flag word is zero, sets a second global word to all ones; otherwise it does nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:020E
name: increment_byte_table_entries
description: Adds 8 to the first byte of each of eighty-nine eight-byte records in the global table, walking the table from its start.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0226
name: reset_game_state_and_objects
description: Resets a large set of game variables, timers and frame counters to fixed defaults, and clears the object and sprite tables. It then points the object handler slots at the routine addresses held in the table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:05DC
name: initialise_object_row_slots
description: When a condition flag is clear, fills a fixed number of object slots in a row from the current position, setting their coordinates, scale and handler pointer, and then sets the fields of one fixed object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:072C
name: save_and_replace_handler_pointer
description: Saves the 32-bit value stored at the pointer held by the current object into a global, then writes the address of a routine into that location.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0742
name: restore_saved_handler_pointer
description: Writes the value saved by its counterpart back into the location pointed to by the current object, undoing the redirection.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0750
name: update_scroll_and_frame_timer
description: Writes a scroll value from an eight-entry table to the playfield control register, stepping a scroll counter down and clamping it at zero. It also counts a frame timer, which resets at fifty or sixty frames depending on a mode flag, and moves the stored routine pointer on by 256 bytes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:07AC
name: update_timer_copy_display_registers
description: Counts a frame timer up to fifty and, when a flag is set, copies seven saved values into the bitplane, display window and sprite registers of the custom chip block. It also sets the DMA control and display mode words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:085E
name: write_display_window_registers
description: Stores fixed words into the display window start and stop registers and sets two further fixed words in the DMA control and interrupt enable registers of the custom chip block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:087C
name: write_saved_values_through_pointers
description: Writes four saved 32-bit values through four stored pointers, restoring them to their destinations.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:08AE
name: relocate_pointer_tables
description: Sets two flag bits on a byte in the caller's block, then adds the global block base to every 32-bit entry in two tables, with counts taken from globals, which turns stored offsets into absolute addresses.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:08D2
name: relocate_pointer_tables_only
description: Adds the global block base to every 32-bit entry in two tables sized by two stored counts, without touching any flag byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:08F8
name: run_active_object_handlers
description: Clears two global flags, then calls a routine for each non-empty object slot among the first five entries and calls the stored handler for each non-empty slot among the next three.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0936
name: track_nearest_object_motion
description: Scans the object records for the nearest one whose flag bits match, and when none matches it advances the current object by its velocity using sine and cosine tables and counts down a timer. It returns a status, and a close match sets a flag and copies coordinates into a result table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:09BA
name: copy_result_record_to_slot
description: When a called test routine returns zero, calls five routines and copies three words from a result record into a table slot chosen from a bit field of a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0A0E
name: advance_object_motion_and_timer
description: Advances one object by its velocity from a sine and cosine table, scaled by its current speed, and counts down its timer. While the object is live it returns zero; otherwise it saves its handler and coordinate fields into globals, clears its state word and returns a failure code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0A20
name: seek_nearest_object_and_advance
description: When the object has no target yet, searches the records for the nearest matching one and stores it there. It then advances the object by its velocity from the sine and cosine tables, counts down its timer, and returns zero while it is live or saves three fields to globals and returns a failure code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0A6E
name: copy_result_on_second_check
description: When one test routine returns nonzero and a second returns zero, it calls five routines and copies three words of a result record into globals along with a saved index value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0A78
name: advance_object_or_copy_result
description: Either copies a result record into globals after two test routines pass, or advances the object's velocity and position from the sine and cosine tables while counting down its timer. The moving path saves three fields to globals and returns a failure code when the timer ends.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0AB0
name: copy_result_record_after_check
description: After one test routine returns zero, calls five routines and copies three words from a result record into the global result slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0B0A
name: step_toward_target_on_axis
description: Moves the object along one axis toward a target by a speed-limited step clamped to its range, then calls a test routine. When that returns zero and the object is inside a distance window, it saves the object's handler and coordinates and returns a status.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0B1C
name: apply_clamped_axis_step
description: Applies a clamped step along one axis using the step value passed in a register, then returns a status when a test routine returns zero inside the distance window.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0B58
name: apply_axis_step_and_check
description: Adds a clamped step to one coordinate of the object, then calls a test routine and, when it returns zero inside the distance window, saves the handler and coordinates into globals and returns a status code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0B7A
name: check_window_and_retire_object
description: Takes the absolute value of one offset, adds a second offset, and compares the result with a window derived from a stored value. Inside the window it saves the object's handler and coordinates into globals and returns a failure status.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0BC0
name: dispatch_object_handler
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in the object's handler field at offset sixteen.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0BC6
name: process_object_hit_and_motion
description: Advances the object's motion, then tests it against a target through a called routine. On a close hit it sets a hit flag on the object, records the hit position in a table slot and appends an entry to a linked list, returning a hit code; otherwise it keeps moving the object and returns a status.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0D72
name: advance_object_with_decaying_counter
description: Reduces one counter field of the object by a step scaled by the speed divisor, raises its speed up to a limit, and moves its position and velocity from the sine and cosine tables. It returns zero while the object is live and saves its fields to globals when it ends.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0D8A
name: advance_object_motion_only
description: Raises the object's speed up to a limit and moves its position and velocity from the sine and cosine tables, counting down its timer. It returns zero while the object is live and saves its fields to globals when it ends.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0EC2
name: check_proximity_and_set_state
description: When a global flag is clear and the object is within a fixed distance of a reference position, it sets the state field to three and returns a hit code. A closer distance also sets a global marker byte to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0F04
name: check_distance_band_for_state
description: Sets the object state field to ten, and when its distance from the reference position falls outside a band scaled by a stored counter it returns a hit code and sets the state to thirteen. A closer distance also sets a global marker byte to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0F5A
name: check_distance_band_marker
description: Sets the object state field to ten, then returns a hit code with state four when the distance is outside a band scaled by a stored counter. A closer distance sets a global marker byte to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:0FA8
name: register_object_as_active
description: When the object's flag bit is clear, sets it and stores the object's handler, copies its position into globals, clears a field of a linked object when it is zero and records the object's slot id, then returns zero. Otherwise it returns a failure code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:103E
name: claim_object_slot
description: Marks the object as in use and clears its timer, then records it in one of two fixed slot globals and returns zero. It returns failure when the in-use flag is already set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1168
name: advance_counter_and_reset_timer
description: When a global flag is clear, adds one plus a stored value to a counter, calls a routine, and sets a timer global to fourteen.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:118E
name: test_object_within_range_window
description: Returns zero only when a size field scaled by four is no larger than the passed value and the offset from a reference lies inside a window derived from a stored counter. Otherwise it returns failure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:11AC
name: test_distance_window_for_object
description: Returns zero when the offset of the object from a reference position lies inside a window derived from a stored counter, and failure otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:11D6
name: test_size_and_far_offset
description: Returns zero when a size field scaled by four is no larger than the passed value and the object's offset from a reference lies beyond a fixed distance. Otherwise it returns failure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:11F4
name: test_offset_beyond_distance_limit
description: Returns zero when the object's offset from a reference position is more than a fixed distance away, and failure otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:120A
name: update_slot_countdowns
description: Walks all object slots, clearing a flag on inactive ones and counting down a per-slot timer on live ones. A timer that reaches zero is reloaded from a rate value, and at a specific count with a negative global the routine calls a handler and sets a flag bit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1280
name: fire_projectile_from_object
description: Sets a timer from a threshold table when a test returns nonzero, and records the object's position and velocity in a shared record. When the trigger conditions are met it copies the object's fields into a free entry of a fixed table and increments a counter; the text FIRING is referenced, so the routine launches a shot from the object.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:146A
name: scale_record_value_by_speed
description: Returns zero when the record's counter is zero or minus one. Otherwise it calls a routine and returns a value scaled from a stored field and the current speed value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:14B6
name: latch_flag_run_slot_handlers
description: Copies a per-frame flag from one global to another and clears the source, then calls the handler stored at offset thirty-two of each object slot in turn.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:14E8
name: select_nearest_idle_object
description: When enough slots remain and the interval since the last event exceeds a rate value, finds the closest object whose flag bits match, records the current event counter, and calls two routines for it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1576
name: move_object_and_fire_shots
description: Raises the object's speed up to a limit, moves it along its velocity using sine and cosine tables, and counts down its life. At the end of its life it retargets to the nearest matching object, and it copies the object into a shot table when the timing and range tests pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:15DE
name: steer_object_and_fire
description: Steers an object with its velocity from sine and cosine tables while it is beyond a short distance, and resets its velocity and handler when it is close. It then counts down its life, retargets at the end and copies the object into a shot table when the timing and range tests pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1678
name: decay_object_motion_and_fire
description: Reduces a timer field each frame and, when it reaches zero, clears the object's state and resets its handler. Otherwise it moves the object along its velocity using sine and cosine tables, counts down its life and copies it into a shot table when the timing and range tests pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:169A
name: advance_object_in_last_slots
description: Runs the same sine and cosine motion, life countdown and shot table test as its neighbours, but only for the final object slots in the list. It also sets the object's flag bits and handler on entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:16B6
name: advance_object_and_fire_shot
description: Sets the object's flag bits and handler, then advances it along its velocity using sine and cosine tables and counts down its life. At the end of life it retargets to the nearest matching object, and it copies the object into a shot table when the timing and range tests pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:16D0
name: ramp_object_speed_then_move
description: Ramps the object's speed toward its limit, and once the limit is reached it clears a flag bit and restores the saved handler. It moves the object along its velocity from the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:16DE
name: accelerate_and_move_object
description: Adds a fixed step to the object's angle field when it is slow, ramps its speed toward its limit, and moves it along its velocity from the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1708
name: restore_handler_and_move_object
description: Clears a flag bit, restores the object's saved handler, and moves it along its velocity from the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1718
name: home_object_toward_target
description: Ramps the object's speed toward its limit and, while a stored counter is below its limit, tests whether a target lies within range on both axes. When the range test passes it sets the object's steering values toward the target and counts the hit in a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1904
name: steer_object_from_target_code
description: Derives a steering value from a passed code, using a timing bit when the code is the sentinel value of five hundred and twelve. It clamps that value against the object's speed, then updates its velocity and position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1940
name: steer_object_from_passed_code
description: Derives a steering value by shifting a passed code, clamps it against the object's speed, and updates its velocity and position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1960
name: retarget_object_on_timing_mask
description: Every frame when a timing mask matches, it searches up to eight slots for one that passes a distance test and retargets this object to it, clearing its flags when the distance is too large. It then ramps the object's speed toward its limit and moves it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:197C
name: search_slots_and_ramp_speed
description: When a timing mask matches, searches up to eight slots for one passing a distance test and retargets the object to it. It then ramps the object's speed toward its limit and moves it along its velocity.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A14
name: scan_slots_for_distance_match
description: Scans object slots, decrementing a count, until one lies within a distance limit of a reference value and passes a second test. It then ramps the object's speed toward its limit and moves it along its velocity.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A1E
name: clear_object_handler_and_flags
description: Stores the routine address as the object's handler, clears most of its flag word and zeroes a state field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A32
name: compute_scaled_offset_from_object
description: Returns the difference between a passed position and the object's stored position field, shifted down by five bits, together with two further values from the routines it calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A6A
name: stub_immediate_return
description: A stub that does nothing but return, so it has no behaviour beyond the call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A7A
name: steer_object_toward_position
description: Computes a speed step toward a passed position, clamped to the object's limits or to a fixed maximum when a flag bit is set. It then updates the object's velocity and position from the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A88
name: steer_object_toward_position_direct
description: Steers the object toward a passed position with clamped velocity steps, then updates its velocity and position from the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1A98
name: clamp_speed_and_steer_object
description: Clamps a passed speed to a minimum, derives a clamped velocity step from the difference to the object's position, and updates its velocity and position from the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1AB0
name: apply_minimum_speed_and_move
description: Raises a passed speed to a minimum, adds the resulting step to the object's velocity, and moves it along the sine and cosine tables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1AF0
name: update_heading_and_move_shot
description: Adjusts the object's angle by a clamped rate, wraps it when it grows large, and moves the object along the sine and cosine tables. The text fired by is referenced, which points to shot tracking.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1E7E
name: retire_object_and_store_record
description: When an object's remaining count is below one it clears its flags and sets its handler, then saves its handler, coordinates and count into globals. It also updates the pointer to the current object and stores a record into a slot table chosen from the frame counter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialise_takeoff_object_state
description: Sets an object's position, velocity and state from a passed template, offsetting its height by a global value. The text taking off is referenced, so the routine sets up a launch.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:1FFA
name: set_speed_scale_and_init
description: Derives a speed scale divisor from a stored value, clamped between four and fifteen and halved when a flag is set, then derives two speed limits from it and calls several routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_countdowns_and_return
description: Decrements two stored countdown globals when they are nonzero and returns the byte held in the low register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_two_countdowns
description: Decrements two stored countdown globals when they are nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:20F6
name: update_gunfire_shots_and_hits
description: Advances the active shot records by their velocity, counts down each record's life and checks each one's distance against the reference position. The messages destroyed by gunfire and hit by gunfire are referenced, so hits from gunfire are resolved here.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:22C2
name: update_records_or_clear_slot
description: When no reference record is set, it picks a slot from the frame bits and clears it. Otherwise it steps eight records' positions by their velocities and increments their velocity fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:234C
name: decay_stored_velocity_step
description: When a stored value is positive, reduces a second stored value by a fixed step down to a floor and adds it to the first.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:2372
name: store_status_words_and_mark
description: Sets a marker byte to all ones and stores two status words into the game block, then calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:23A2
name: clamp_position_globals_and_update
description: Derives two position globals from velocity accumulators, clamps them to fixed minimum and maximum limits, and calls several routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:2466
name: snapshot_position_and_raise_timers
description: Copies the current position and angle globals into a result record, then raises each active object's timer field to at least a level-scaled minimum.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:24B6
name: find_closest_flagged_record
description: Scans the object records whose flag bits match, keeping the one with the smallest distance to the reference, and stores it in a global pointer for later use.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:259C
name: call_linked_handler_result
description: Clears a global, calls a routine, and when the linked object pointer is set it calls a second routine and returns its result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:25A0
name: call_linked_handler_and_clear
description: Clears a global, calls a routine, and when the linked object pointer is set it calls a second routine, returns its result and clears the global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:25E6
name: initialise_timed_slot_object
description: When an object's flag eight is clear, selects a slot from the frame bit and, if that slot is free, zeroes its word, sets its flags and handler, and stores default values of 1000 and 250.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:266C
name: find_best_scored_record
description: Scans the object records, scoring each with a routine that starts from minus 32000, and records the winner in globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:2710
name: select_best_scored_record
description: Scores the current record against the object list, starting from a sentinel of 6400, and returns a pointer to the record with the best score.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:5FE6
name: compute_range_overlap_code
description: Compares an interval, given as a centre and half-width pair, against two limits held in globals and returns clipping flags, with a bit set for each limit it crosses.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:5FEA
name: range_overlap_code_entry_b
description: Entry point into the same range clipping routine as its neighbour, which returns clipping flags for an interval against two limits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:5FEE
name: range_overlap_code_entry_c
description: Entry point into the same range clipping routine as its neighbours, which returns clipping flags for an interval against two limits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:5FF2
name: range_overlap_code_entry_d
description: Entry point into the same range clipping routine as its neighbours, which returns clipping flags for an interval against two limits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:5FF6
name: compute_range_overlap_code_full
description: Computes clipping flags for an interval against two limits, with a longer path that handles more flag combinations before it returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:62B2
name: clip_range_and_call_handlers
description: Computes clipping flags for an interval against two limits and, for certain flag combinations, clips the interval to the nearer limit and calls five routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:63C6
name: check_scaled_magnitude_overflow
description: Takes the absolute values of two passed components and returns a flag when the smaller is below the larger and the larger plus half the smaller would exceed the signed 16-bit range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:63F6
name: compute_signed_pair_quotient
description: Takes the absolute values of two signed 16-bit operands, handles zero and sign cases, and returns a packed result from a 32-bit division of the magnitudes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:64B0
name: compute_signed_pair_quotient_long
description: Divides two signed operands by their magnitudes with sign handling and returns a packed 32-bit result, using a longer path for large operands.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:65A8
name: append_position_record
description: Appends a record to the list whose end pointer is in the game block, storing the frame counter, the high bytes of the position and two passed bytes, then advances the pointer if there is room.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:65EA
name: copy_string_to_global_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated string from a source pointer into the global text buffer, byte by byte, stopping after the terminator.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:65F8
name: append_string_to_global_buffer
description: Finds the terminating null of the global text buffer and copies a null-terminated source string onto its end.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:660C
name: format_signed_decimal_text
description: Writes a signed 16-bit value into a text buffer as decimal digits, with a minus sign for negative values, by dividing by ten thousand and then smaller powers of ten. The text minus thirty-two thousand seven hundred sixty-seven is referenced.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:6654
name: format_comma_separated_number
description: Writes a 32-bit number into a text buffer as decimal digits with a comma separator between the groups of thousands.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:669A
name: copy_indexed_longword_to_slot
description: Copies a longword from a table, indexed by a passed word, into the slot just below the frame pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:66A2
name: format_three_digit_text
description: Writes a 16-bit value into a text buffer as hundreds, tens and ones digits, then terminates the string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:66D6
name: select_offset_for_record_state
description: Returns a stored value from the record when its high flag bit is clear. Otherwise it returns one of two global values with 256 added, chosen by the result of a test routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:6700
name: test_nibble_against_two_globals
description: Returns minus one when the low nibble of the record word at offset eighteen matches one of two stored values, and zero otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:671C
name: fill_text_buffer_with_spaces
description: Fills forty-eight bytes of a global text buffer with spaces and calls one routine to finish the setup.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:68BC
name: pack_bitplane_words_with_table
description: Combines bits from four consecutive words through a lookup table, four rows at a time, and writes packed nibble values until a zero count ends the loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:692A
name: restore_saved_register_block
description: Reloads a block of saved longword globals from fixed memory and then calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:6934
name: copy_frame_state_block
description: Copies a block of longword globals to or from the game block, with the direction chosen by a counter, and then calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:6D2A
name: process_hunk_records
description: Compares record type values against the AmigaDOS hunk type codes and copies the fields for each match, as part of executable loading or relocation.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:713A
name: store_hunk_header_fields
description: Stores a group of longword fields into the game block and compares values with the AmigaDOS hunk type codes during executable loading.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:722A
name: multiply_word_and_swap_halves
description: Multiplies the low word returned by a called routine by a passed word and returns the product with its two halves swapped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:723C
name: advance_pseudo_random_seed
description: Advances a stored 16-bit seed by multiplying it by forty-one and adding seventy-three, a linear congruential pseudo-random step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:725E
name: queue_pending_event_record
description: When a passed value is within a limit and the pending counter is below six, resets the counter from the speed scale and stores a passed value and pointer as the pending record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:728A
name: draw_text_string_glyphs
description: Reads a null-terminated string, upper-cases lowercase letters and looks up each character's eight-byte glyph in a table for drawing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:737E
name: draw_text_glyphs_to_planes
description: Reads a null-terminated string and looks up eight-byte glyph rows for each character, writing them through several bitplane pointers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:7472
name: stub_immediate_return
description: A stub that does nothing but return, so it has no behaviour beyond the call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:7484
name: start_blitter_copy_operation
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then loads its source, destination, modulo and control registers from the object's fields and starts the operation.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:751C
name: stub_return_zero
description: A stub that returns zero and does nothing else.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:7520
name: append_object_record_to_table
description: Stores the object's state fields into a table entry chosen by a passed index, multiplied by fourteen bytes, and advances the index counter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:7566
name: transform_points_with_fixed_point
description: Splits passed coordinates into integer and fraction parts and processes a list of points through several routines, storing fixed-point results.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:79A6
name: find_matching_key_record
description: Scans a table of fourteen-byte records for one whose four key words match the stored values, and returns the byte the record index is kept in when a match is found.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:79B6
name: search_key_record_entry_b
description: Entry point into the same record search, which returns a byte when a fourteen-byte table record matches four stored key words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:79BA
name: search_key_record_entry_c
description: Entry point into the same record search, which returns a byte when a fourteen-byte table record matches four stored key words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[t +4 goonies]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[t +4 Goonies].adf:game:0:79C2
name: search_key_records_backwards
description: Walks a fourteen-byte record table from its last entry backwards, comparing the stored key words, and stops at the first record that matches.

name: match_coordinates_in_record_table
